name: Redis server (official source release)
license: BSD-3-Clause (COPYING in the 7.2 source release; later Redis lines changed license)
build_requirements: a C compiler and make; the build uses only the bundled dependencies (jemalloc, lua, hiredis, linenoise, hdr_histogram, fpconv)
distribution: Source is downloaded and built locally; no binaries are vendored. Compiled outputs are not byte-reproducible across compilers, so the pin is the source checksum plus the reported server version.
